senses.gloss: (cmp. רָצַץ), Pi. רִיסֵּס to crush, break into small pieces.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Nazir 6:1:9">Y. Naz. VI, 54ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>רִסְּסָן ואכלן</he> (or <he>רְסָסָן</he>) if he chopped them (the aṇts) and ate them (v. <cite ref="T00861"><he>רָסַק</he></cite>).

<cite ref="Mishnah Oktzin 2:5">Ukts. II, 5</cite>, sq. <he>עד שׁיְרַסֵּס</he> until he has cracked or broken the shell (and taken out the contents); <cite ref="Tosefta Uktsin 2:15">Tosef. ib. II, 15</cite> <he>אע״פ שרי׳ … לפרק</he> although he has cracked the shell, the connection is not considered broken until he begins to pick; <he>וביצה טרומיטא אע״פ שרי׳ וכ׳</he> (not <he>טרמיסא</he>) and in the case of a boiled-down egg (v. <cite ref="I00726"><he>טרומיטא</he></cite>) the connection remains, although he has crushed it, until he begins to peel it; a. e.—Part. pass. <he>מְרוּסָּס</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 8:5">Sabb. VIII, 5</cite> <he>אם היה עב או מר׳</he> if the reed is thick or cracked.

<cite ref="Chullin 77a:7">Ḥull. 77ᵃ</cite> <he>מִתְרוֹסֵס מהו</he> if the flesh covering the wound is lacerated, how is it? <cite ref="Sotah 11a:19">Sot. 11ᵃ</cite> (play on <he>ר̇עמ̇ס̇ס̇</he>, <cite ref="Exodus 1:11">Ex. I, 11</cite>) <he>ראשון ראשון מ̇תר̇וס̇ס̇</he> (Ar. s. v. <cite ref="Q00895"><he>פיתום</he></cite>: <he>מתמסמס</he>) one building after the other was crushed (fell in); <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 1">Ex. R. s. 1</cite>.
